summary: Super Productivity is a self-hosted task management application featuring built-in time tracking and timeboxing tools. It allows you to organise your daily workload while connecting directly to external issue trackers such as Jira, GitHub, GitLab, Redmine, and OpenProject.
goodFor: Developers and project managers who want to combine personal task organisation, time tracking, and issue tracker synchronization within a single interface.
watchOut: Relying on external issue tracker integrations means you will need to manage API tokens and network access permissions for each connected service.
deployNotes: Since it is distributed as a Docker container, you will typically need to configure persistent storage for your application data and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
